entries.source: You have survived the onslaught of undead. You notice a way to climb up you had not seen before in a wall nearby.
entries.target: 你从亡灵的猛攻中存活了下来，你看到旁边的墙上有一条之前没有发现的通路，可以爬上去。

entries.source: Way into a strange lush forest
entries.target: 通向一片奇怪的葱郁森林的道路

entries.source: Suddenly it comes back to you. You remember long ago somebody told you about a strange lush forest... If only you could remember where!
entries.target: 突然你想了起来。很久以前曾有人向你提起过一片奇异而葱郁的森林……要是你还能记得它在哪里就好了！

entries.source: As you walk into the area you notice a huge snowstorm over your head. Beware!
entries.target: 当你进入这个区域时，你感觉到一股暴风雪在你的头顶盘旋。小心！

entries.source: #VIOLET# The stairway collapses completely as you ascend!
entries.target: #VIOLET# 当你爬上楼梯的时候，楼梯彻底坍塌了！

entries.source: #VIOLET# The decrepit stairs crumble some more as you climb them.
entries.target: #VIOLET# 你爬上这段破旧的楼梯时，它又崩塌了一些。

entries.source: Crumbling stairs lead down to something.
entries.target: 摇摇欲坠的楼梯向下通往某处。
向下的楼梯，已经坍塌了。

entries.source: As you walk into the area you notice a huge thunderstorm over your head. Beware!
entries.target: 当你进入这个区域时，你感觉到一股暴风雨在你的头顶盘旋。小心！

entries.source: Do you wish to disturb the grave?
entries.target: 你想要挖掘这个坟墓吗？

entries.source: #CRIMSON#Your timetravel has no effect on pre-determined outcomes such as this.
entries.target: #CRIMSON#你的时间穿越对这种已经预设好的结局没有任何作用。

entries.source: You were not the first here: the corpse was turned into an undead.
entries.target: 你不是第一个来到这里的：那个人的尸体已经变成了亡灵。

entries.source: Do you wish to inspect the pedestal?
As you inspect it a shadow materializes near you, and suddenly it is no more a shadow!
entries.target: 当你检查这个基座时，一团阴影出现在你身旁，突然间它凝成了实体！

entries.source: %s's soul is absorbed by the pedestal. A glowing orb appears.
entries.target: %s的灵魂被基座吸收了。一个发光的球体出现了。

entries.source: You hear a terrible voice saying 'Their lives are mine! I am coming!'
entries.target: 你听到一个可怕而低沉的声音：“他们的生死由吾掌控！吾即将降临！”

entries.source: This door seems to have been sealed off. You think you can open it.
entries.target: 这扇门似乎被封住了，你觉得你可以打开它。

entries.source: This door seems to have been sealed off. You need to find a way to open it.
entries.target: 这扇门似乎被封住了，你需要设法打开它。

entries.source: This door seems to have been sealed off. You need to find a way to close it.
entries.target: 这扇门似乎被封住了，你需要设法关闭它。
